content.bridge_context: Understanding balance and patterns in shapes.

units.title: Line of Symmetry
units.explanation: An imaginary line that divides a shape into two identical halves that are mirror images.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify lines of symmetry in the letter 'A'. / अक्षर 'A' में सममिति (symmetry) की रेखाओं को पहचानें।

units.title: Rotational Symmetry
units.explanation: A shape has rotational symmetry if it looks the same after a rotation of less than 360°.
units.dual_language_instruction: Does a ceiling fan have rotational symmetry? / क्या छत के पंखे में घूर्णी सममिति (rotational symmetry) होती है?
